title: 第7章 活力橙汁第8章 一阶装备暴富
content_zh:
可惜，后面连续八次，都没有再出元气茶，【祛湿茶】和【宁神茶】，【蚀魂茶】这三种是几率最高的。
反而新的茶品又陆续问世，【清凉茶】，【健脾茶】及一种有害的【渗骨茶】。
变异的方向太多了，想要得到自己期待的那一种，不知要尝试多少次，最后方南山也只能放弃。
“可能是茶水有很强的可塑性，千变万化，难以捉摸，还是试试果汁吧。”
两斤橙子，也就是四五个，他还是特意没挑大个的那种。
他先尝试直接榨汁，没添加其他东西，也没有调配操作。
很快就出了成品，过滤了碎渣后只有浅浅的一点，不够喝一口。
心里默念完成，杯子里的浑浊果汁忽然被某种神秘力量改造，变得清澈无比，一阵阵橙果香味飘上来。
【清凉橙汁（0阶二星）：解渴，消除疲倦，增加食欲，短暂提升身体活力。】
“什么东西？就这？”
方南山多少感觉有些心疼，仿佛被坑了一个碎片，它跟不变异有区别吗？而且才二星，茶水都至少四星的，这也太少了。
可能是操作的步骤太少了？没有让碎片能量充分发挥改造？
“加水加糖再试。”
第二杯更让他无语。
【腐臭橙汁（0阶三星）：充满腐烂气味的恶臭果汁，降低食欲，破坏免疫力，有腹泻，催吐，全面降低个体所有属性的功效。】
“再来！”
清理完厨房洗手盆的恶臭味，杯子也反复冲洗，消毒，扫描过没有残留，才咬着牙继续下一个。
【活力橙汁（0阶三星）：消除疲劳，恢复体力，让身体细胞充满活力，加快治愈内外伤，提升个体免疫力，长期饮用可提升体质。】
“这个还不错，提升免疫力还有疗伤功能，并且增强体质，适合病人饮用。”
元气茶太难出了，这个活力橙汁虽然效果差很多，但还算不错，如果出的几率较高，以后可以常备饮用。

后面两个橙子，又出一个恶臭的成品，另一个是清凉橙汁，但是品质达到三星，效果好一些，也有解渴消乏提升活力的效果，只是没有活力橙汁好。
还行吧，两种试验品，都还是正面效果更加多一点，负面变异虽然也有，但几率要低一些，正品殾对身体有良好的提升，别看都是少量微量的，但只要每天坚持，身体素质会得到慢慢提升。
方南山总结分析一下今晚的产品数据，总体上是满意的，这个灵魂异化的天赋，是一个实用的天赋，就是以后要多搜集一些灵魂碎片，现实世界虽然也经常有人员死亡，但他并不想去守株待兔，更不可能因此而动杀心。
“明天有空可以去肉菜市场转一下，还有海鲜市场和饭馆，可惜附近没有屠宰场，不知这些小动物会不会有灵魂碎片，如果有，可以去找找看哪里有蚂蚁窝……”
content_en:
It's a pity that for the next eight consecutive times, no more vitality tea was released. [Dampness-Removing Tea], [Ningshen Tea], and [Soul-eating Tea] are the three with the highest probability.
Instead, new tea products have come out one after another, such as [herbal tea], [spleen-strengthening tea] and a harmful [bone tea].
There are too many directions for mutation. If you want to get the one you are looking for, you have to try many times, but in the end Fang Nanshan can only give up.
"Maybe it's because tea is highly malleable, ever-changing and elusive. Let's try juice."
Two kilograms of oranges, that is, four or five, but he deliberately did not pick the big ones.
He first tried to squeeze the juice directly, without adding anything else or blending.
The finished product came out very quickly. After filtering out the crumbs, there was only a small amount, not enough to take a sip.
After finishing the silent recitation, the turbid juice in the cup was suddenly transformed by some mysterious power and became extremely clear, with bursts of orange fruit fragrance floating up.
[Refreshing orange juice (level 0, two stars): quenches thirst, eliminates fatigue, increases appetite, and temporarily increases physical vitality. 】
"What? That's it?"
Fang Nanshan felt a little distressed, as if he had been trapped into a fragment. Is it different from the unmutated one? And it's only two stars, and the tea is at least four stars, which is too little.
Maybe there are too few steps? Didn't the energy of the fragments give full play to the transformation?
"Add water and sugar and try again."
The second cup left him even more speechless.
[Rancid orange juice (level 0, three stars): A foul-smelling juice full of putrid smell, which reduces appetite, destroys immunity, causes diarrhea, induces vomiting, and comprehensively reduces all attributes of an individual. 】
"Come again!"
After cleaning up the stench from the kitchen wash basin, the cups were rinsed and disinfected repeatedly, and after scanning and checking that there were no residues, I gritted my teeth and moved on to the next one.
[Vitality Orange Juice (level 0, three stars): eliminates fatigue, restores physical strength, makes body cells full of vitality, accelerates the healing of internal and external injuries, and enhances individual immunity. Long-term drinking can improve physical fitness. 】
"This is not bad. It improves immunity and has healing functions. It also enhances physical fitness. It is suitable for patients to drink."
Vitality tea is too difficult to come out. Although this vitality orange juice is much less effective, it is still pretty good. If the probability of coming out is higher, you can always drink it in the future.
The next two oranges produced another stinky finished product, and the other was a refreshing orange juice, but the quality reached three stars and the effect was better. It also had the effect of quenching thirst and improving energy, but it was not as good as the energetic orange juice.
It's okay. Both experimental products have more positive effects. Although there are negative variations, the probability is lower. The genuine product has a good improvement on the body. Although it is only a small amount, as long as you persist every day, your physical fitness will slowly improve.
Fang Nanshan summarized and analyzed tonight's product data. Overall, he was satisfied. This talent of soul alienation is a practical talent. He needs to collect more soul fragments in the future. Although people often die in the real world, he does not want to wait and wait, let alone be murderous because of it.
"If you have time tomorrow, you can go to the meat and vegetable market, as well as the seafood market and restaurants. Unfortunately, there is no slaughterhouse nearby. I wonder if these little animals have soul fragments. If so, you can go look for ant nests..."
